movelist.name: Water Pulse
movelist.effect: Water Pulse Confuses the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Water Sport
movelist.effect: All targets in the burst, including the user, gain a Coat which grants them 1 Step of Resistance to Fire Type Moves. After a target has been hit by a damaging Fire Type Move, the coat is removed.

movelist.name: Twister
movelist.effect: Small or Medium targets in the central square of the blast are not hit. Twister Flinches the target on 18-20 during Accuracy Check. Any Pokémon Airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop above the Blast are hit, ignoring range, and Twister has a Damage Base of 8 against those targets instead.

movelist.name: Refresh
movelist.effect: The user is cured of all Poison, Burns, and Paralysis.

abilities.name: Competitive
abilities.effect: Whenever the user has its Combat Stages lowered, by something other than its own Moves or Abilities, the user’s Special Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages.
